def solution():
    # Define variables
    net_income = 1_200_000
    roas = 0.045
    op_cash_flow = 1_500_000
    prev_op_cash_flow = 1_200_000
    long_term_debt = 4_800_000
    prev_long_term_debt = 5_000_000
    current_ratio = 1.5
    prev_current_ratio = 1.3
    new_shares_issued = False
    gross_margin = 0.38
    prev_gross_margin = 0.35
    asset_turnover = 1.2
    prev_asset_turnover = 1.1

    # Calculate the Piotroski score
    score = 0
    score += net_income > 0
    score += roas > 0
    score += op_cash_flow > 0
    score += op_cash_flow > net_income
    score += long_term_debt < prev_long_term_debt
    score += current_ratio > prev_current_ratio
    score += not new_shares_issued
    score += gross_margin > prev_gross_margin
    score += asset_turnover > prev_asset_turnover

    # Return the answer
    return int(score)
